title: ElevenLabs' new app combines meeting note-taking and dictation for teams | TechCrunch
summary: The newest entrant in that category is voice AI giant ElevenLabs , which this week released an experimental app called ElevenAI that combines meeting note-taking, dictation, and agent integration. Ivan covers global consumer tech developments at TechCrunch.
